up: Return a list of all approved drugs (max_phase = 4) that have an indication for pain. For each drug, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, the indication ID (mesh_id), the indication label (mesh_heading), and the max phase.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, md.max_phase FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading LIKE '%pain%'
